newsitem.title: CHINA: Tibet company to raise 57 mln yuan from issue.
newsitem.headline: Tibet company to raise 57 mln yuan from issue.

text.p: Tibet Holy Land, Tibet's first industrial company set to list on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, said it will raise 57 million yuan ($6.8 million) from the issue.

Tibet Holy Land, which produces mineral water and operates a tourist agency and hotel in the Tibetan capital of Lhasa, would issue 15 million A shares at four yuan a share on September 12, the company said in a statement.
This would raise 57 million yuan after deducting three million yuan for the issuing fee, it said.
After the issue, the A shares would account for 30 percent of the company's share capital, with the rest held by state-owned institutions in Sichuan and Tibet, it said.
In the first half of 1996, the company posted net profit of 1.922 million yuan on turnover of 9.75 million, against net profit of 1.562 million on turnover of 14.45 million in all 1995, it said.
In the first half of 1996, it had earnings per share of 0.05 yuan and had 1.23 yuan in net assets per share, it said. ($1=8.3 yuan)
